title: Block reduction with sequential addressing, from scratch (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
Single block of 256 threads reducing 256 elements to out[0].
smem_waves threshold is set just above the reference's own measured value (45); an interleaved/modulo tree reduction measures 150 on the same input.
